stories.title: Royal Mint releases first 10p coins bearing King Charles III’s portrait
stories.summary: The first 10p coins to carry King Charles III’s portrait have entered circulation, and every one of them was struck in Wales. stories.title: RNLI Flint asks public to report anyone tampering with life rings after Hawarden Bridge incident
stories.summary: Volunteers at Flint Lifeboat Station cut short a training exercise after finding a life ring tied to Hawarden Bridge and left hanging over the water. stories.summary: A man has been arrested after North Wales Police stopped a vehicle travelling on the wrong side of the A55 on Anglesey this evening (Monday 24 August). stories.title: Councils could order fly-tippers to clear up waste under government proposals
stories.summary: Fly-tippers could be made to clear up waste and pay the cost of the clean-up instead of being taken to court, under proposals now out for consultation.
